identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of IL-1 Receptor Antagonist Anakinra to Prevent Severe Neurotoxicity and Cytokine Release Syndrome in Patients Receiving CD19-Specific Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T Cells

primaryOutcomes.measure: Arm 1 (CAR T Cell Group) Rate of Severe Neurotoxicities
primaryOutcomes.description: Determine the rate of severe neurotoxicities, \>/= Grade 3 or any grade seizure, within the first 4 weeks of treatment with prophylactic use of anakinra in participants receiving CD19-specific CAR T cells

primaryOutcomes.measure: Arm 2 (COVID-19 Group) proportion of patients able to avoid death or mechanical ventilation
primaryOutcomes.description: proportion of patients able to avoid death or mechanical ventilation within 28 days from the start of the treatment.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 28 days from the start of treatment

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients (age \>/= 18) with a diagnosis of relapsed CD19+ B-cell ALL, MCL, or NHL receiving commercially approved CD19-specific CAR T cells (e.g. tisagenleuleucel, axicabtagene, brexucabtagene autoleucel, etc) are eligible for the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with uncontrolled systemic fungal and bacterial infections
* Patients with known hypersensitivity to E. coli-derived proteins
* Women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum or urine pregnancy test (women who have undergone surgical sterilization or who have been postmenopausal for at least 2 years are not considered to be of childbearing potential)
* Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding
